### Executive Summary
The Foundation for Defense of Democracies (FDD) has urged the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) and the National Security Agency (NSA) to evaluate vaultless, keyless pseudonymization. This technology is being advocated as a potential defensive safeguard to protect organizations against ransomware attacks.

### Technical Impact & Root Cause
The policy recommendation addresses the ongoing risk of ransomware operators compromising and exfiltrating sensitive organizational data. By evaluating vaultless, keyless pseudonymization, security frameworks aim to reduce reliance on traditional key vaults and centralized key management systems, which can be vulnerable during a breach. Specific technical implementation standards and impact metrics are not yet confirmed.

### Mitigation & IOCs
Organizations and regulatory bodies are advised to evaluate vaultless, keyless pseudonymization methodologies as part of their broader data security and ransomware mitigation strategies.
